name: Gabby's Dollhouse
description: This colorful series leads preschoolers room to room through a fantastical dollhouse of delightful mini-worlds and irresistible kitty characters.

videos.title: Spaceship
videos.overview: Gabby and Pandy unbox their first surprise, show off their shrinking skills and take to the dollhouse for a meowt-of-this-world mission.

videos.title: Gabby Gets the Hiccups
videos.overview: It’s time for another dollhouse delivery! Gabby and Pandy share their new Meow Meow Mail with Cakey and work on a cure for a sneaky case of hiccups.

videos.title: Hamster Kitties
videos.overview: A fuzzy delivery contains a cuddly surprise for Baby Box. In the dollhouse, Gabby and Pandy attempt to keep up with some cute and crafty critters.

videos.title: Kitty School
videos.overview: As Floyd settles in for a tasty treat, Gabby grabs a new piece of mail from the Meow Meow Mailbox and prepares for an action-packed day at kitty school.

videos.title: Kitty Cat Cam
videos.overview: Fun is only a snapshot away as Gabby and Pandy set out to take a group photo — and make time for a picture-perfect scavenger hunt!

videos.title: Dollhouse Defenders
videos.overview: Super Gabby and Super Pandy shrink down to save the day from a mischievous CatRat. Can they solve his playful puzzles? Let the marvelous missions begin!

videos.title: Mixed-Up Dollhouse
videos.overview: A sparkly Meow Meow Mailbox surprise leads to a mysterious dollhouse mix-up. Can Gabby and the kitties find a fix... and some bubbly fun?

videos.title: Game Show
videos.overview: Ready. Set. Compete! CatRat takes center stage and hosts a series of dazzling dollhouse games. Will the crew win enough tickets to take home prizes?

videos.title: Kitty Pirates
videos.overview: Gabby and Pandy delight in a day of pirate-themed adventures, featuring music, maps and magical travel. Cakey leads a tasty treat tutorial.

videos.title: MerCat Gets Her Sparkle Back
videos.overview: Mush, mash and mix in a dash! Gabby and her friends prepare for a spa day. Meanwhile, MerCat deals with a sparkle disaster. Can the gang find a fix?

videos.title: Itty Bitty Blossom
videos.overview: A darling delivery leads to a garden adventure when Gabby and Pandy call on Kitty Fairy and crew to help grow and soothe an itty bitty blossom.

videos.title: Dollhouse Store Day
videos.overview: It’s almost time to get groovy at the music store grand opening! Can Gabby and Pandy earn enough kitty coins to buy an instrument?

videos.title: Kitty Fairy’s Sleepover
videos.overview: As Floyd snuggles up for bedtime, Gabby, Pandy and Pillow Cat prepare for a sleepover in Kitty Fairy’s garden, complete with a magical pajama tree.

videos.title: Let's Make a Movie!
videos.overview: Lights, camera, CatRat! Gabby and the gang help turn a beloved fairy tale into a movie and get crafty with costumes, props and sound effects.

videos.title: Pete the Polar Bear
videos.overview: A frosty friend from the North Pole pays a visit to the dollhouse and learns all about the splish-splash spirit on his very first beach day.

videos.title: Kitty Rangers
videos.overview: Gabby and Pandy receive special sashes and start their journey as kitty rangers! Can they use their new skills to solve a missing mama mystery?

videos.title: The Meow-Mazing Games
videos.overview: Get ready to race, jump and fly as Gabby, Pandy, Carlita and the DooDads compete for a big, beautiful Meow-Mazing Games trophy!

videos.title: Pandy's Birthday
videos.overview: Next stop: Birthday Island! In honor of Pandy’s big day, Gabby prepares a heartfelt gift, and the dollhouse friends celebrate with a series of surprises.

videos.title: The Dollhouse Hotel
videos.overview: A tiny suitcase surprise leads to a fancy hotel stay for Gabby and Pandy, featuring "cat-abulous" spa treatments and a popping pool party.

videos.title: A Knight’s Tail
videos.overview: Gabby and Pandy become knights in training and practice bravery by crossing a moat, mixing potions and more.

videos.title: DJ's Glow Ride
videos.overview: It's time to light up the night with a glow-in-the-dark delivery; Gabby, Pandy and DJ Catnip get to work on a train-building project.

videos.title: Rainy Day Banana
videos.overview: Inspired by a sparkly banana, Gabby and her friends make the most of a rainy day in the dollhouse and craft songs and snacks.

videos.title: CatRat the Bandit
videos.overview: Gabby and Pandy say "howdy" to a cowboy adventure as they hit trails and rails to protect a pouch of golden nuggets from CatRat.

videos.title: DJ Catnip Gets His Groove Back
videos.overview: Gabby, Pandy and DJ Catnip are ready to make music and search high and low for moving and grooving sounds.

videos.title: Kitty Fairy Gets Sick
videos.overview: After Kitty Fairy catches a cold, Gabby and Pandy deliver dandelion soup and step in to save the day.

videos.title: Cakey’s Cupcake Cousins
videos.overview: It's cousin time; Bakey, Flakey, Marshapan, and Paddycake visit Cakey and the dollhouse gang for a "sprinkle-rific" day of yummy snacks and hug attacks.

videos.title: It’s Purrsday!
videos.overview: Gabby and friends go all out for an extra special holiday, throwing a "paw-tastic" party, complete with homemade decorations and dessert.

videos.title: Dollhouse Safari
videos.overview: Gabby, Pandy and their curious crew set out on an animal safari to find a mysterious creature.

videos.title: Fluffy Flufferton
videos.overview: Glittery and glamorous Fluffy Flufferton is the most "a-meowzing" pop star; the gang helps her shake things up before a big concert.

videos.title: Abra-CAT-Dabra!
videos.overview: A tiny top hat delivery leads to a dazzling day for new magician Baby Box; meanwhile, her closest friends help her perform a boppin'-and-hoppin' trick.

videos.title: The Fairy Festival!
videos.overview: It's fairy o'clock and the start of a fantastic festival, featuring rides, games, cotton candy, and a new friend with a flower contest dream.

videos.title: Dollhouse FairyTales
videos.overview: Tall tales come to life with a king, a mermaid and so much more as Gabby and the gang create and celebrate enchanting fairytales in a storybook castle.

videos.title: The Easter Kitty Bunny
videos.overview: Gabby and Pandy practise patience as they wait for a super cute egg to hatch; luckily, Kitty Fairy, MerCat and DJ Catnip are there to lend helping paws.

videos.title: Gabby, I Shrunk the Kitties!
videos.overview: When Gabby and Pandy turn tiny from one of MerCat's potions, they'll need to gather the right ingredients to help them grow back to their usual size.

videos.title: Mission to CATurn
videos.overview: Gabby and Pandy blast off to Planet Caturn after CatRat gets stuck there looking for space cheese.

videos.title: Doodlebook
videos.overview: Gabby finds a book with the same doodle on every page; inside the dollhouse, the Gabby Cats use their imagination to add their own spin to the drawings.

videos.title: Cupcake Tree
videos.overview: Cupcake expert Cakey helps Gabby and Pandy shrink down a giant cupcake tree to rescue CatRat and the Gabby Cats from its overgrown branches.

videos.title: Dollhouse Detectives
videos.overview: Gabby and Pandy play detectives when things start to suddenly and mysteriously disappear around the dollhouse.

videos.title: Happy CAT-O-Ween!
videos.overview: Everyone's in the Cat-O-Ween spirit; Gabby and Pandy make cat-o-lanterns with Baby Box, search for treats with MerCat, and make banana ghosts with Cakey.

videos.title: A CAT-Tabulous Christmas
videos.overview: Meow-y Christmas! Gabby and Pandy have some Christmas wishes — but first they need to help Figgy the Elf learn from her present-wrapping mistakes.

videos.title: CatRat's Puzzle Hunt
videos.overview: CatRat takes Gabby and Pandy on a puzzle hunt through the dollhouse, where they solve riddles, play games and find fun surprises along the way.

videos.title: Super Thinkers!
videos.overview: While completing an obstacle course to become superheroes, Gabby and Pandy learn how to use their bodies — as well as their minds!

videos.title: Paper Cup Popper
videos.overview: After Gabby finds a box of paper cups, the friends get creative making paper cup animal crafts, telling stories and playing fur-tastic games.

videos.title: Dollhouse Dress-Up Chest
videos.overview: Gabby uses the power of dress-up to travel to the Wild West, outer space and even underwater to help solve her friends' problems.

videos.title: Kico the KittyCorn
videos.overview: On a rainy day, Gabby and friends must take care of Kico — a baby KittyCorn who's part kitty, part unicorn — until it's time for her to meet her family.

videos.title: Planes, Trains, and Kitty Balloons!
videos.overview: Gabby and Pandy take a travel adventure using a train, plane, cruise ship and hot air balloon — but they can't forget to take pictures for CatRat.

videos.title: True Fairy Friends
videos.overview: A glowing lantern leads Gabby and Pandy to a Fairy Fly House! But to meet their new neighbor, they'll need to prove they're helpful, kind and welcoming.

videos.title: Googly Eyes
videos.overview: When Gabby and Pandy find a magical jar of googly eyes, they're in for a troublemaking surprise. Luckily MerCat knows just how to burst trouble's bubble.

videos.title: Spongey-Saurus
videos.overview: Roar! Stomp! When Spongey-Saurus gets wet, he grows. When he dries out, he shrinks. Can Gabby and Pandy keep their new dino-pal the perfect size?

videos.title: Baby Box’s Meow-Seum Day!
videos.overview: The Gabby Cats need to make a special art project for Baby Box's Meow-Seum Day. But with many different ways to make art, who knows what they'll create!

videos.title: Carlita the Ice Cream Truck!
videos.overview: Carlita has transformed into an ice cream truck! Before she can deliver sweet treats to all the Gabby Cats, she'll need ice cream, a menu and a song.

videos.title: The Magical Mermaid-Lantis
videos.overview: SunnyCat invites Gabby to a Mermaid Sparkle Party in Mermaid-Lantis! But to attend, she needs to bring MerCat's blue crystal — and her special sparkle.

videos.title: Snow Cruise
videos.overview: Gabby and Pandy learn all about snow science when they take a cruise to the North Pole to see a rainbow igloo that Pete the Polar Bear and CatRat built.

videos.title: Baby Benny Box Is Here!
videos.overview: The Box Family welcomes its newest member: Benny Box! When Mama Box needs a nap, Gabby and Pandy teach Baby Box how to babysit her new brother.

videos.title: The Mermaid Cruise Ship
videos.overview: Gabby's going on a mermaid cruise! There are a ton of fun activities to do aboard the ship, like making mer-mazing crowns, tails and treats.

videos.title: Charm Bracelet Treasure Hunt
videos.overview: Gabby and Pandy follow clues and solve riddles to find sparkly treasures on an a-meow-zing Dollhouse Treasure Hunt. Can they find all three?

videos.title: CatRat’s KittyFish
videos.overview: When Gabby receives a fishbowl in her Meow Meow Mailbox, CatRat wants to use it as a home for his itty bitty kittyfish. But they keep hiding!

videos.title: The Mermaid Christmas Cruise
videos.overview: Santa Kitty is on his way to the Mermaid Christmas Cruise to give the first present of the year to MerCat's baby sister Hsiu Hsiu — and we're invited!

videos.title: Music Festival
videos.overview: When Gabby and Pandy score party passes to DJ Catnip's music festival, they board a groovy bus to watch shows featuring all their favorite Gabby Cats.

videos.title: Cakey's Birthday
videos.overview: Cakey runs out of sprinkles on the most sprinkle-riffic day of the year: his birthday! Can Cakey's friends figure out a way to bring his sprinkles back?

videos.title: Pandy's Bad Day
videos.overview: After messing up his hug attack and getting a hole in his Pandy Pack, Pandy realizes he's having a bad day — but things just keep getting worse.

videos.title: Baby Box's Crafty-riffic Adventure
videos.overview: Gabby receives a Crafty-riffic Adventure Kit in her Dollhouse Delivery, which comes in handy when CatRat spends the day crafting silly bad guys.

videos.title: Silly Kitty Cubes
videos.overview: Gabby brings her Silly Kitty Cubes with her to the dollhouse, where all the Gabby Cats play along by making up fun stories based on what they've rolled.

videos.title: Carlita's Ameowzing Race
videos.overview: It's the day of Carlita's A-meow-zing Race! After choosing their racers, Gabby and her friends speed around solving puzzles to win a special surprise.

videos.title: Happy Birthday, Gabby!
videos.overview: CatRat wants to plan a party for Gabby's birthday, but Gabby can't decide on a theme. Will she make up her mind in time for his big surprise?

videos.title: Marty the Party Cat
videos.overview: There's a new Gabby Cat in town: Marty the Party Cat! Gabby and Pandy show Marty all the fun features in the party room to make him feel welcome.

videos.title: You Wish!
videos.overview: Gabby gets a wishing fountain and helps make the kitties' wishes come true, but Pandy can't decide what he wants — until CatRat gets into a pickle!

videos.title: CatRat's Birthday Surprise
videos.overview: It's CatRat's birthday! Help Gabby and the gang plan a super-secret surprise party for their feline friend and his very special guest, Fluffy Flufferton.

videos.title: Craft Bot
videos.overview: Baby Box's Kitty Bots cause confusion in the dollhouse when they wind up in the wrong rooms. Can you help the cat pals find where the robots belong?

videos.title: Grandma CatRat
videos.overview: CatRat wants everything to be perfect for his grandma's visit. But when things don't go as planned, the day is full of new and exciting surprises.

videos.title: Kitty Care Ear
videos.overview: The Gabby Cats lend a paw to help Gabby care for adorable little ones inside the dollhouse's new Kitty Care Ear — the purr-fect place for babies!

videos.title: Benny's First Tooth
videos.overview: Benny Box has a big smile — and his first tooth! After Kitty Fairy teaches Benny how to use a toothbrush, it's party time with a special guest.

videos.title: Happy Kitty-tine's Day!
videos.overview: Follow the candy trail? No problem! Kitty-tine's Day leads to treats, songs and crafts as Gabby and friends find creative ways to say "I meow you."

videos.title: Baby Alien Kitty
videos.overview: A surprise arrives for Gabby: a mysterious egg containing a Baby Alien Kitty named Googie who needs to get back to their mama. Maybe you can help!

videos.title: Pillow Cat Can't Sleep
videos.overview: Pillow Cat can't sleep, so the gang tries to help. Cakey makes a bedtime snack, DJ Catnip spins "The Yawn Song" — but CatRat's idea might do the trick!

videos.title: Family Day
videos.overview: It's Kitty Family Day! The Gabby Cats make fun surprises to show their appreciation for each other — with the help of Gabby's magic charm bracelet.

videos.title: The Wizard of Meow
videos.overview:
With the help of Pandy the Scarecrow, Baby Box the Tin Box, and Marty the Party Lion, Gabby must go to Emerald Kitty City and meet the Wizard of Meow, while dodging obstacles from “Bad Witch” MerCat along the way!

Cat of the Day: MerCat sings “Spa Science”.

videos.title: Cakey's Cabinet Café
videos.overview:
Cakey reveals an adorable mini eatery inside his kitchen cabinet! Gabby, Pandy and maitre d’CatRat help Cakey get all the things he needs to get his tiny restaurant ready for his tiny customers, the Hamster Kitties!

Cat of the Day: Cakey makes a doughnut kitty.

videos.title: How to Train Your Kitty Dragon
videos.overview:
CatRat the Brave meets a baby kitty dragon who gets stuck on a marshmallow tower in the Kingdom of Squish. It’s up to brave knights Gabby the Bold and Pandy the Purr-oud to help CatRat rescue his dragon friend, only to discover he can’t see very well and needs an eye exam.

Cat of the Day: Baby Box, with the help of Sparkle, makes a fire breathing dragon.

videos.title: The Magic Bananas
videos.overview: Gabby unboxes special magic bananas where there’s a little magic in every bite! Silly shenanigans ensue in the Dollhouse with the Gabby Cats taking turns surprising one another with their magical powers.

videos.title: Good to Be a Gabby Cat Game Show!
videos.overview: Gabby hosts a game show in her bedroom, where the Gabby Cats are contestants as they celebrate the memories from the littlest wins to the biggest whoopsies.

videos.title: The Secret World of Fairylandia
videos.overview: Gabby and friends enjoy the a-meow-zing lights of Fairylandia for the first time and get ready for the secret world's biggest celebration of the year!

videos.title: Fairy Appreciation Day
videos.overview: One of MerCat's magic potions makes Kitty Fairy lose her wings. Can Gabby and the gang help Kitty Fairy get her wings back on her special day?

videos.title: Kitty Bear Tea Party
videos.overview: Follow Gabby and pals for a paw-some tea party in Fairylandia! The group decorates stuffed bears, bakes cookies and takes a magical tea cup ride.

videos.title: Pandy and the Kitty-Pillar
videos.overview: Pandy picks a name for a cute Kitty-Pillar friend, then the Gabby Cats serve some tasty fruits and veggies to help her grow into a Kitty-Butterfly!

videos.title: Opposite Day
videos.overview: It's Opposite Day in the Dollhouse, and to celebrate the occasion, Gabby unboxes Opposite Cat, who can make any opposite magic happen! Whether it's upside down, slow and fast, short and tall, big and small, all the Gabby Cats' opposite dreams come true.
